name: Easel
text: I’ll pull Eitan’s latest design picks from the shared drive (folder: `/design-references/eitan-picks/2024-q2/`), then extract the top 10 high-res screenshots into a new Figma board named `Mine AI - Eitan’s Taste Reference`. name: Squint
text: Squint here—why assume Eitan’s 2024-Q2 picks are still *relevant* today? A folder timestamp doesn’t equal enduring taste. Pull the last 3 months of his *actual* usage data (e.g., Slack reactions, Figma comments) to prove these screenshots weren’t just abandoned experiments. And if you’re scoring "quality-first," where’s the rubric? A 1-5 heuristic without documented criteria is just vibes—show me the *why* behind the numbers.
